lessons_used: No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.4% overall).
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) tends to have a negative impact, as 3 tests agree after noise correction (-3.5% overall).
New adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) tend to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-1.8% overall).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign) showed no clear effect across tests.
Evidence remains thin for home flows (home, new_flow) with only 1 test, and predictions were consistently overly optimistic.

candidates.title: Story Screen Narrative Split Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the story screen into a split layout separating the app intro narrative from setup options.
candidates.why: Story step has high drop-off before path selection and long average time (514s mean in choose_path step).

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Choose a narrative backstory and customize your pet experience directly on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns story screen while continuing to introduce the pet.

candidates.score_note: Choose path redesigns historically show neutral effect (0.0%), and no support email points to narrative issues.

candidates.title: Sign In Screen Account Recovery Notice
candidates.change: Display a prominent hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to log in with their original account to preserve existing pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different account.

sign_in.hint: Returning user? Sign in with your original account to restore your existing desktop pets.

guard.reason: Adds account recovery hint to sign-in screen without modifying required functionality.

candidates.score_note: High evidence with 8 support emails reporting pet loss at sign-in. Simple hint config change.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Format Guidance Badge
candidates.change: Add an explicit photo guidance hint and recommendation badge on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or incorrect visual output, and adoption step drop-off is high at 60.9%.

upload_photos.hint: For best custom pet results, upload clear front-facing photos with bright lighting.

guard.reason: Adds upload guidance and recommendation badge to photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop-off (39.1%) and 3 support emails report photo format issues.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Interaction Sound & Mascot
candidates.change: Add time estimation and an animated mascot with calm ambient sound to the waiting screen during pet creation.

guard.reason: Adds time estimation, progress, sound, and mascot during actual pet creation wait.

candidates.score_note: Home drop-off is relatively low (18.7%); adding mascot and sounds requires full new assets.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Controls Quick Reference

home_intro.headline: Desktop Pet Controls

components.text: Click and drag to move across desktop

guard.reason: Redesigns home intro quick reference within onboarding bounds.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from emails/funnel, but finish redesigns/new screens consistently regressed (-3.5%).

candidates.why: Choose path step conversion is 76.2% with a mean completion time of 514s.

guard.reason: Updates choose path layout while maintaining path options.

candidates.score_note: Target step drop-off is moderate, and past path selection redesigns showed no clear benefit.
